messages:
jamie: dropping a quick design sanity check for the autoscale card updates pushed to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/yyyy/autoscale-v2 (frames: slo-preview, pool-dialog, stepper). main asks: 1) UX for switching GPU pools (intent + progress), 2) 'block fallback' option microcopy + placement, 3) keyboard/aria behaviors for min/max controls. thoughts? :mag:
nora: looked through frames. the pool switch flow feels like it promises instant change. we should surface 'staged' state: i.e., 'Routing update queued' then 'Routing update applied'. avoid implying zero downtime.
devin: Agreed. Suggested modal copy: header 'Switch route pool', body 'New requests will be directed to Pool Gamma. Existing requests may continue on the current pool until drained.' CTA: 'Confirm switch' secondary: 'Cancel'. After confirm show a small inline progress card: 'Applying change  draining connections  remapping traffic'.
frank: on the progress card, add a small estimated time range. engineers tell me common move is ~20-60s. microcopy: 'Applying change  traffic will fully migrate in ~200s.' keep it realistic.
jamie: good. UX question: should we add an 'Undo' inside the progress card? or rely on activity log rollback?
nora: I think immediate undo in the snackbar is helpful. make it ephemeral (90s) and call it 'Revert pool switch'. backend can implement a symmetric API for quick rollback if no persistent config changed.
devin: agree on 90s. Note: if the pool switch triggers instance reallocation that takes longer, undo may be a best-effort. we should show status after undo attempt. add toast 'Rollback requested  attempting to re-route' then final success/failure states.
frank: copy for 'block fallback' checkbox (in advanced settings): current label 'Disable fallback' is a bit negative. suggest 'Prevent automatic fallback' with help text 'If enabled, requests may be throttled instead of using backup pools when burst capacity is exhausted.' link to policy docs.
ajay: oops, I'm not in thread but +1 to preventive wording. Also prefer an explicit 'why this matters' tooltip.
a11y-bot: accessibility flags: 1) stepper must expose role="spinbutton" with aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax/aria-valuenow. 2) ensure increment/decrement buttons are keyboard focusable <button> elements and not only SVGs. 3) when slider updates cost-preview show aria-live="polite" on the preview element. 4) progress card should update with role="status" and aria-atomic="true".
jamie: thanks — we'll implement those. Devin: the stepper currently uses left/right arrow shortcuts; any concerns about conflicts with page-level keyboard shortcuts?
devin: capture arrow keys only when the stepper is focused. implement onKeyDown on the spinbutton container and preventDefault for up/down/left/right as needed. provide visible focus ring.
nora: visual contrast nit: the fallback badge (orange) uses same hue as 'warning' elsewhere; users may conflate them. maybe use a subtle outlined badge with an icon (loop/refresh) and keep warning for errors only.
frank: good call. Also for the SLO slider, the cost delta preview should show both relative and absolute impact: e.g., '-10ms = +$0.03/hour'. we should avoid over-precision; show rounded values.
ajay: include a keyboard-only accessible tooltip for the SLO slider label explaining cost/latency tradeoffs. use a focusable info icon.
a11y-bot: confirm: tooltip must be reachable by keyboard, have role="tooltip" and be controlled via aria-describedby on the slider.
jamie: final thing: activity log items for fallback/pool-switch should include policy & reason. example entry: '2026-04-03 09:21  Route /api/chat used fallback pool Delta due to burst limit; policy=latency-first; migrated by autoscale service'. include link to pool details.
nora: OK I'll update the Figma frames: add progress card variant, snackbar undo text, revised block-fallback label/help, and a11y annotations for spinbutton and tooltip.
devin: I'll scope the front-end changes: stepper -> semantic spinbutton + key handlers, progress card + status updates, and connect the snackbar undo to the rollback API.
frank: i'll update copy doc with suggested microcopy and the short/long variants for toasts (short for activity feed, long for the toast).
a11y-bot: checklist added to the design task: spinbutton semantics, focus-visible token use, aria-live for cost preview, role=status on progress updates, keyboard-accessible tooltip.
jamie: thank you all  aiming to finalize by end of sprint. drop any leftover comments on the Figma frames. :white_check_mark:
